steps.step: Report lag = date reported - date occurred
Victim age: 0, negative or >100 is not a real age -> missing
Victim sex: only M/F kept; X, H, '-' and blanks -> 'Unknown'
Coordinates: 0,0 or outside Los Angeles -> missing
Crime descriptions grouped by keyword rules
Weapon: blank Weapon Used Cd means none recorded (67% of rows)
Premise: keep the 20 most common, rest -> OTHER
Mocodes kept as text for the MO-pattern analysis
Outcome from Status (AA/JA = Arrest); rare UNK/CC statuses dropped
Restrict to incidents up to 2023-12-31 (2024 is incomplete)
